scope: 在腾讯云隔离环境开发实际画面检查，验证等待原因、出牌权限与窄屏中英文提示。
rendering: X11 virtual display and Mesa llvmpipe software OpenGL; actual rendered pixels, not headless
network: Image setup uses package repositories; actual renderer has network disabled and no player accounts.
source_storage: Reuse only byte-verified immutable task-owned resource snapshots; preserve original raw evidence and all source file bytes.
cleanup: Exact owned container ID and label required for teardown; production and unrelated resources preserved.
acceptance_limits: Component RENDER evidence does not prove full natural three-cycle LIVE, human usability, hardware FPS or capacity acceptance; formal task states remain separate.
delivery: Each completed stage summarized locally and pushed directly to release
